query.sql: SELECT date, control_point, arrival_departure, hk_resident_net_flow, mainland_visitor_net_retention FROM immd_daily_passenger_traffic;
query.description: Daily passenger clearance by control point, direction and residency, used to derive HK-resident net flow and Mainland-visitor net retention.

query.sql: SELECT period, mid_year_population_thousands, natural_growth_thousands, net_movement_thousands FROM csd_population_estimates;
query.description: Half-yearly population estimates, natural change and net movement (One-way Permit holders vs. others), 1961-present.

query.sql: SELECT quarter, claims_count, amount_mhkd FROM mpfa_permanent_departure_claims;
query.description: Quarterly MPF claims for permanent departure from Hong Kong (count and amount), parsed from the official Statistical Digest.

query.sql: SELECT academic_year, mainland_students, other_non_local_students, total_non_local FROM ugc_student_enrolment;
query.description: Annual UGC-funded programme enrolment by university, level of study, mode of study and place of origin, 2010/11-present.

sources.label: Transport Department Monthly Traffic and Transport Digest

query.sql: SELECT month, hzmb_vehicular_traffic, hzmb_northbound_hk_vehicles, express_rail_passengers FROM td_cross_border_traffic;
query.description: Monthly HZMB vehicular traffic (incl. Northbound Travel for HK Vehicles 港车北上) and cross-boundary passenger traffic incl. Express Rail West Kowloon.

query.sql: SELECT date, region, visitors FROM censtatd_visitor_arrivals;
query.description: Monthly visitor arrivals by nationality/region since 2004, a geographic companion/cross-check to ImmD's cross-border passenger data.

blocks.body: **Data snapshot:** `f453debf80af92c9` · generated 2026-08-14T07:50:46.561943Z.  This is a published snapshot, not a live connection. Official ImmD, C&SD, MPFA, UGC and TD open data.

## Reading the Population, Migration & Cross-Border Monitor

This monitor combines high-frequency daily cross-border passenger flow (ImmD) with official low-frequency structural series: C&SD half-yearly population estimates and net movement (One-way Permit holders vs. others), MPFA quarterly permanent-departure claims, UGC non-local student enrolment, and Transport Department cross-boundary vehicle/rail traffic. Insurance Authority Mainland Visitor premium statistics are not shown: the regulator suspended that series from Q1 2025 pending a review of scope and criteria, and no real substitute source exists. No investment recommendation is produced.
